title: GRH sanitary workers protest in Madurai for bonus and wage hike

tea.why: Contractual sanitation and essential service workers at Government Rajaji Hospital protested due to low wages and financial difficulties.
tea.want: Workers demanded a festival bonus, a wage hike, regularised working conditions, leave policies, and workplace safety measures.
tea.changed: Nov 2, 2026: Workers staged a demonstration, submitted a petition to the District Collector, were temporarily detained by police, and later released.

summary: Contractual sanitation and essential service workers at Government Rajaji Hospital in Madurai held a demonstration within the hospital premises on Monday, pressing for a festival bonus, wage hike, and regularised working conditions. Organised under the Labour Liberation Front, a trade union affiliated with the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi, the protest affected regular cleaning, ward maintenance, and patient tracking services. Workers demanded a Deepavali bonus, daily wage increases, mandatory leave days, PF and ESI credits, strict shift enforcement, and protective gear. According to reports, police detained the protesters, who were later released in the evening. District Collector Nishant Krishna assured workers of a partial bonus, a wage increase, and one paid monthly leave day, while hospital authorities engaged with union representatives to resolve the issues and restore normalcy.
demands: Mandatory days off and leave policies
Strict enforcement of a seven-hour shift with overtime pay
Essential protective gear like gloves, boots, masks, and soaps
response: Police detained the workers during the demonstration, and they were released later in the evening. District Collector Nishant Krishna assured a ₹3,000 bonus, a ₹200 wage increase, and one paid monthly leave day. Hospital authorities also engaged with union representatives to restore normal operations.

crowd.text: Around 750 private contractual workers employed at the Government Rajaji Hospital

arrests.text: police personnel to detain the workers. They were released later in the evening
